pages.text: Once awakened, a $(#9b5de5)mana bar$() rests beside your hotbar. Mana slowly refills on its own.$(br2)You know one spell by instinct: $(l)Spark$().
pages.title: Mana and Casting

pages.text: $(li)$(k:key.hollowmancy.cast_spell): cast your selected spell$(li)$(k:key.hollowmancy.cycle_spell): switch to your next known spell$(li)$(k:key.hollowmancy.open_spellbook): open your Spellbook$(br2)The Spellbook is where you learn new spells and choose which one to cast. Keys can be changed in Controls, under $(l)Hollowmancy$().
